title: Learning aligned EEG representations with subject-specific encoders
abstract: arXiv:2606.16462v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Cross-subject EEG decoding promises more training data, but it also exposes neural networks to strong inter-subject distribution shifts. We study whether task supervision and architecture alone can learn subject-aligned representations. We replace a shared EEG encoder with subject-specific encoders followed by a common classifier, and compare this hybrid model with standard EEGNet, AttentionBaseNet, and CTNet baselines with Euclidean Alignment (EA) on three motor-imagery datasets and one motor-execution dataset. EA improves shared encoders by recentering subject covariances, whereas the hybrid encoder reduces reliance on EA: removing EA has little effect on validation-loss dynamics or latent-space organization, and both hybrid variants consistently outperform non-aligned shared baselines. Subject-specific heads increase class distinctiveness and place each subject close to its own latent manifold while improving within-subject

translated_title: 使用被试特定编码器学习对齐的EEG表征
translated_abstract: 跨被试EEG解码有望获得更多训练数据，但同时也会使神经网络面临强烈的被试间分布偏移。我们研究了仅依靠任务监督和网络结构是否能学习到被试对齐的表征。我们用被试特定编码器后接共享分类器的架构替代共享EEG编码器，并将这种混合模型与标准的EEGNet、AttentionBaseNet和CTNet基线模型（配合欧几里得对齐EA）在三个运动想象数据集和一个运动执行数据集上进行比较。EA通过重新对中被试协方差来提升共享编码器的性能，而混合编码器则降低了对EA的依赖：移除EA对验证损失动态或潜在空间组织几乎没有影响，且两种混合模型变体始终优于未对齐的共享编码器基线。被试特定的输出头增强了类别区分度，使每个被试靠近其自身的潜在流形，同时提升了被试内（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出用被试特定编码器加共享分类器的混合架构替代共享EEG编码器，能够学习到被试对齐的表征，显著降低对欧几里得对齐预处理的依赖，并在多个运动想象与运动执行数据集上持续优于共享编码器基线。
en_tdlr: A hybrid architecture using subject-specific encoders followed by a shared classifier learns subject-aligned EEG representations, reduces reliance on Euclidean Alignment preprocessing, and consistently outperforms shared-encoder baselines across multiple motor-imagery and motor-execution datasets.
